headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the previous edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has become the war’s busiest ledger, rising to forty base events in twenty-four hours and eleven in the latest two hours. Its holdings stand at six Colonial and three Warden bases, while casualty rates have cooled even as enlistment activity accelerates. MooringCountyHex has eased from the earlier tally to thirty-four daily events, with two in six hours and none in the latest two; the Wardens hold eleven bases to one Colonial. StlicanShelfHex has quickened to fourteen daily events, including three in two hours, and now shows five Colonial and four Warden bases amid accelerating casualties and enlistments. PalantineBermHex has advanced to eight events, five in six hours, with two Warden and five Colonial bases. StonecradleHex has fallen to fourteen daily events and remains quiet in the latest six hours, while LinnMercyHex retains three events, including a recent sequence at Rotdust. FarranacCoastHex has cooled to three daily events, with no recent movement. Most other regions report no ownership events.
